quiz.title: Budgeting Basics - Knowledge Check
quiz.description: Test your understanding of basic budgeting concepts.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of a budget?
options: To plan how you will use your income
questions.correctAnswer: To plan how you will use your income
questions.feedback: Correct! A budget helps you plan your income, expenses, and savings.

questions.question: Which of the following is usually a fixed expense?
questions.feedback: Correct! Rent is generally a regular fixed expense.

questions.question: Which expense can change from month to month?
questions.feedback: Correct! Variable expenses can change depending on your spending.

questions.question: Which of these is generally a need?
questions.feedback: Correct! Basic food is an essential need.

questions.question: Why is saving money important?
options: It helps prepare for future goals
questions.correctAnswer: It helps prepare for future goals
questions.feedback: Correct! Saving can help you work toward future financial goals.

resultMessages.excellent: Excellent! You understand the basic budgeting concepts.
resultMessages.good: Good job! Review the topics you missed and try again.
resultMessages.needsPractice: Keep practicing! Review the Budgeting Basics section and try again.
